sharedSOP.title: Standardized MV VFD Commissioning Protocol (13-Step FAT/SAT Procedure)
steps: 1. Mechanical & Ventilation: Verify enclosure installation, top-mounted cooling fans, and ventilation ducts.
2. MV Cabling & Insulation: Inspect MV cable routing and validate Hi-Pot (High Potential) / Megger test reports with the client.
3. Transformer Integration: Verify secondary cable connections of the phase-shifting transformer (for multi-cell configurations).
4. Bypass System Check: Inspect MV incoming/outgoing terminations in the bypass cabinet.
5. Switchgear Readiness: Confirm MV switchgear readiness and verify the availability of MV breaker control power.
6. Mechanical Clearance: Ensure the motor load has physical clearance and conditions for safe rotation.
7. DCS Coordination: Confirm DCS system readiness for joint loop testing.
8. LV Control Power: Verify 380V AC and 220V AC control power connections to the VFD cabinet.
9. I/O & Interlock Testing: Configure and simulate MV interlocking signals and client I/O requirements (DI, DO, AI, AO).
10. Pre-Energization Diagnostics: Final earth/ground checks. Execute MV energization for VFD self-diagnostics (power cell and transformer sampling checks).
11. Uncoupled Auto-Tuning: Decouple the motor and execute no-load dynamic auto-tuning to establish motor models.
12. Load Commissioning: Re-couple the motor and execute under-load trial runs, tuning PID and dynamic responses.
13. Handover & Training: Execute final SAT (Site Acceptance Testing) and deliver comprehensive operator training.
